Aisha marks places to rest on the map. Her brother checks the weather and opening times. They are not going to rush through every attraction. Instead, each person chooses one place and explains why it matters. Their guide includes clear directions, rest stops and an alternative plan for rain. A good city break works for the people taking it.

story: Before the hiking trip, Sam checked his backpack with an adult. He packed water, a coat and a simple map. When the group reached the meeting point, the guide explained the route and the weather plan. Sam was excited because the landscape looked different from his town. After they crossed a small bridge, they stopped at a marked rest area. The walk was tiring, so they drank water and rested before continuing.
